channel.title: Adeeb Noor — Essays
channel.description: Essays on AI, institutions and evidence.

item.title: Same Scores, Different Decisions: What AI Evaluation Can Miss
item.description: I argue that evaluation should follow a score into the decision it produces, including who receives an opportunity when capacity is limited.

item.title: Capacity Is a Policy Choice
item.description: I believe the number of opportunities a system can allocate belongs in the explanation of its decisions. A model cannot take responsibility for a limit the institution chose.

item.title: Define the Position Before Filling It
item.description: I believe institutions need a defensible description of the work before they ask AI to classify a role, recommend a requirement or assess a candidate.

item.title: Readiness Needs Evidence
item.description: I want to know what a student can explain, test and defend when the conditions change. A polished submission gives me only part of that answer.
